RAVI KUMAR THOKALA Marathahalli, Bangalore 560037 | 8142842996 | ravidil8142@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Associate (Emerging Lead) with 4+ years of experience in Trade Processing, Trade Settlements, Reconciliations, and OTC Derivatives. Skilled in end-to-end trade lifecycle management, exception handling, cash and position reconciliations, client servicing, and process improvement within capital markets operations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills with a proven track record of delivering high-quality results within SLA timelines.

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

Recognized for handling complex reconciliation breaks, NAV-impacted trades, and critical trade queries with accuracy and efficiency at State Street. Responsible for processing 500+ trades daily while consistently meeting cut-off times and SLA deadlines. Earned appreciation from Accounting and Client Services for timely issue resolution and trained new team members to ensure operational excellence. Previously, at ICICI Prudential, consistently achieved 170% of monthly sales targets for four consecutive years while leading a team and delivering exceptional business performance.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

State Street Corporation Emerging Lead Senior Associate

2026 – Present 2022 – 2026

Processed and managed end-to-end OTC derivative transactions, including Structured Products, Credit Default Swaps (CDS), Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Equity Total Return Swaps (TRS), and Cross Currency Swaps (XCCY).

Performed trade booking, validation, confirmation, settlement, and lifecycle event processing while ensuring compliance with operational procedures and regulatory requirements.

Coordinated with internal stakeholders, Investment Managers, Fund Accounting, Custodians, Counterparties, and external clients to ensure timely trade processing and settlement within defined cut-off timelines.

Investigated and resolved NAV-impacted trades by identifying root causes, coordinating with relevant teams, and providing timely updates to Fund Accounting and NAV teams.

Ensured all trades were accurately booked within daily cut-off times, minimizing operational risk and settlement failures. • Performed detailed trade reviews to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures and internal control frameworks.

Processed missed or errored trades, corrected booking discrepancies, and eliminated reconciliation breaks through timely remediation.

Conducted daily cash and position reconciliations to ensure accurate portfolio records between Investment Managers, Custodians, and internal systems.

Investigated and resolved position, market value, accrual, cash, and CAB breaks using TLM/TLP reconciliation tools. • Monitored daily accrual reports to ensure accurate interest calculations and timely recognition of income. • Processed dividends, interest payments, and corporate action events on the correct value dates while ensuring accurate accounting treatment.

Managed Past Due Income (PDI), trade settlements, resets, dividend postings, and interest accruals with high accuracy and within SLA timelines.

Responded promptly to accounting, audit, regulatory, and NAV-related queries by providing accurate supporting documentation and analysis.

Participated in monthly, quarterly, and annual audit activities by preparing reports, providing evidence, and ensuring timely closure of audit observations.

Conducted regular calls with Fund Accounting, Income, Dividend, Audit, and Operations teams to resolve operational issues and improve process efficiency.

Supported migration of OTC trade capture activities from global locations and successfully transitioned multiple Investment Manager portfolios.

• Evaluated daily buy-side trade alerts, analyzed operational impacts, and approved Digital Alert System notifications as per

established controls.

• Identified process improvement opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and

strengthen risk controls.

Maintained high levels of accuracy, productivity, and compliance while consistently meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and quality standards.

Collaborated effectively with cross-functional global teams in a fast-paced investment banking environment to ensure seamless trade processing and client satisfaction.

Financial Services Consultant | ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Co. Ltd.

Oct 2017 – Jan 2022

Consistently achieved 170% of monthly sales and productivity targets while managing a high volume of client work, ensuring all insurance policies were issued accurately and on time.

Trained and mentored partner agents and team members, motivating them to achieve their goals, with several qualifying for national and international incentive trips.

Verified customer KYC documentation for authenticity and completeness, promptly flagging discrepancies, and liaised daily with the underwriting team to resolve policy status issues.

Processed insurance claims within a 15-day service standard and handled cash/cheque collections, issuing receipts promptly while maintaining accurate records in the PMS system.

Delivered responsive customer service via phone and email, resolving issues for clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep operations running smoothly.

Recognized with multiple appreciations from Accounting, Client Services, and client stakeholders for prompt and effective issue resolution.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
State Street Corporation Emerging Lead Senior Associate
2026 – Present 2022 – 2026
Processed and managed end-to-end OTC derivative transactions, including Structured Products, Credit Default Swaps (CDS), Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Equity Total Return Swaps (TRS), and Cross Currency Swaps (XCCY).
Performed trade booking, validation, confirmation, settlement, and lifecycle event processing while ensuring compliance with operational procedures and regulatory requirements.
Coordinated with internal stakeholders, Investment Managers, Fund Accounting, Custodians, Counterparties, and external clients to ensure timely trade processing and settlement within defined cut-off timelines.
Investigated and resolved NAV-impacted trades by identifying root causes, coordinating with relevant teams, and providing timely updates to Fund Accounting and NAV teams.
Ensured all trades were accurately booked within daily cut-off times, minimizing operational risk and settlement failures. • Performed detailed trade reviews to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures and internal control frameworks.
Processed missed or errored trades, corrected booking discrepancies, and eliminated reconciliation breaks through timely remediation.
Conducted daily cash and position reconciliations to ensure accurate portfolio records between Investment Managers, Custodians, and internal systems.
Investigated and resolved position, market value, accrual, cash, and CAB breaks using TLM/TLP reconciliation tools. • Monitored daily accrual reports to ensure accurate interest calculations and timely recognition of income. • Processed dividends, interest payments, and corporate action events on the correct value dates while ensuring accurate accounting treatment.
Managed Past Due Income (PDI), trade settlements, resets, dividend postings, and interest accruals with high accuracy and within SLA timelines.
Responded promptly to accounting, audit, regulatory, and NAV-related queries by providing accurate supporting documentation and analysis.
Participated in monthly, quarterly, and annual audit activities by preparing reports, providing evidence, and ensuring timely closure of audit observations.
Conducted regular calls with Fund Accounting, Income, Dividend, Audit, and Operations teams to resolve operational issues and improve process efficiency.
Supported migration of OTC trade capture activities from global locations and successfully transitioned multiple Investment Manager portfolios.
• Evaluated daily buy-side trade alerts, analyzed operational impacts, and approved Digital Alert System notifications as per
established controls.
• Identified process improvement opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and
strengthen risk controls.
Maintained high levels of accuracy, productivity, and compliance while consistently meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and quality standards.
Collaborated effectively with cross-functional global teams in a fast-paced investment banking environment to ensure seamless trade processing and client satisfaction.
Financial Services Consultant | ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Co. Ltd.
Oct 2017 – Jan 2022
Consistently achieved 170% of monthly sales and productivity targets while managing a high volume of client work, ensuring all insurance policies were issued accurately and on time.
Trained and mentored partner agents and team members, motivating them to achieve their goals, with several qualifying for national and international incentive trips.
Verified customer KYC documentation for authenticity and completeness, promptly flagging discrepancies, and liaised daily with the underwriting team to resolve policy status issues.
Processed insurance claims within a 15-day service standard and handled cash/cheque collections, issuing receipts promptly while maintaining accurate records in the PMS system.
Delivered responsive customer service via phone and email, resolving issues for clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep operations running smoothly.
